title: Sordland/Turn01/A_Media
description: Discussions regarding the media strategy ensues. A media meeting is offered by Marcel Koronti and a decision needs to be made whether to go for it or reject it.

entries.title: START

entries.speaker: INPUT
entries.title: input

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“He has offered to meet with you, M..."
entries.dialogueText: “He has offered to meet with you, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“But let's not get ahead of ourselv..."
entries.dialogueText: “But let's not get ahead of ourselves. First, we need to determine our general approach to media.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“The media must be independent.”"
entries.dialogueText: “The media must be independent.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“The media is a tool to be used.”"
entries.dialogueText: “The media is a tool to be used.”
entries.menuText: “The media is a tool to be used.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I agree. Media plays a huge role i..."
entries.dialogueText: “I agree. Media plays a huge role in adapting public opinion towards our views and policies, while helping us avoid damage from scandals or mistakes."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“While I do acknowledge that this w..."
entries.dialogueText: “While I do acknowledge that this will sound a bit harsh, I certainly believe that our perspective, knowledge and experience allows us to have superior judgement compared to the average Sordish citizen."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Ideally, yes. But an unpopular lea..."
entries.dialogueText: “Ideally, yes. But an unpopular leader will not be able to pass even the easiest reforms. It is of utmost importance to maintain public popularity and avoid any damaging scandals or mistakes.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I must stress one thing, Mr. Presi..."
entries.dialogueText: “I must stress one thing, Mr. President. The more people we have supporting our agenda, the more we can accomplish. With someone on our side in an influential media organisation, we can do this very easily.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“I agree with Lucian, but why the a..."
entries.dialogueText: “I agree with Lucian, but why the assumption there'll be scandals and mistakes?”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“They are a powerful and influentia..."
entries.dialogueText: “They are a powerful and influential media conglomerate. To start with, they own the Sordland Today newspaper, the Sordish Broadcasting Corporation, the S-”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“After the passing of his father --..."
entries.dialogueText: “After the passing of his father -- may he rest in peace -- Marcel aims to become the next CEO of the HOS Conglomerate. He mentioned a productive collaboration.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Two wrongs don't make a right.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Two wrongs don't make a right.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I see what you are getting at.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I see what you are getting at.”
entries.menuText: “I see what you are getting at.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“That does sound harsh.”"
entries.dialogueText: “That does sound harsh.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I share your opinion.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I share your opinion.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Maybe, maybe not. It's hard to for..."
entries.dialogueText: “Maybe, maybe not. It's hard to forget what happened to President Alphonso last year.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Things got even worse after his ca..."
entries.dialogueText: “Things got even worse after his cabinet resigned and the media started to slander him, but that was also a result of his own incompetence.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“We can always hope for the best. B..."
entries.dialogueText: “We can always hope for the best. But do we really think that nothing can go wrong? Especially considering the very recent history of Sordland.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Yes, we shouldn't resort to these..."
entries.dialogueText: “Yes, we shouldn't resort to these measures to solve our potential political mistakes.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“It isn't about that alone, Petr. T..."
entries.dialogueText: “It isn't about that alone, Petr. There could be groups or people who would want to damage us even if we are in the right.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“I concur. Even if we don't use it,..."
entries.dialogueText: “I concur. Even if we don't use it, we should be able to have control over it.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“You both are aware of my certain e..."
entries.dialogueText: “You both are aware of my certain expertise with public opinion swaying. I will make sure the media is on our side.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“There are two ways we can approach..."
entries.dialogueText: “There are two ways we can approach the media. One of them is by influencing it, which has clear advantages. The other one is keeping it independent.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“I'm no media expert, but Lucian ma..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm no media expert, but Lucian made some very interesting arguments at the preparation meeting yesterday.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Two knocks were heard on the door."
entries.dialogueText: Two knocks were heard on the door.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Please, come in.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Please, come in.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Who is it?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Who is it?”

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: "“Excuse me, Mr. President. Mr. Gala..."
entries.dialogueText: “Excuse me, Mr. President. Mr. Galade's secretary has been calling me and wanted me to relay a message.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Livia Suno, my new secretary, enter..."
entries.dialogueText: Livia Suno, my new secretary, entered the office.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Korontis had always been known..."
entries.dialogueText: The Korontis had always been known as one of the richest and most influential families in Sordland. Marcel Koronti was no exception.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What does this *productive collabo..."
entries.dialogueText: “What does this *productive collaboration* entail?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Let's consider our options first...."
entries.dialogueText: “Let's consider our options first. No need to be hasty.”
entries.menuText: “Let's consider our options first. No need to be hasty.”

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: "“Marcel Koronti, the new CEO for HO..."
entries.dialogueText: “Marcel Koronti, the new CEO for HOS Conglomerate, is on the line for Mr. Galade.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Well. The ball is in our court now..."
entries.dialogueText: “Well. The ball is in our court now.”

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: "“Right away, sir. Connecting the ca..."
entries.dialogueText: “Right away, sir. Connecting the call to line one.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Livia left the room and the phone s..."
entries.dialogueText: Livia left the room and the phone started ringing. I picked it up.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Good news indeed. Congratulations,..."
entries.dialogueText: “Good news indeed. Congratulations, Mr. Koronti. Thank you for contacting me about this. We will talk later.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian put the phone down."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian put the phone down.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“What was so important that it coul..."
entries.dialogueText: “What was so important that it couldn't wait?”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“He was just elected CEO by the boa..."
entries.dialogueText: “He was just elected CEO by the board of directors. He offered a partnership deal regarding his media branch. He is inviting us to his resort near Conriat for a meeting.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Arrange the meeting with Mr. Koron..."
entries.dialogueText: “Arrange the meeting with Mr. Koronti.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I do not want to associate with a..."
entries.dialogueText: “I do not want to associate with a media mogul. Reject the offer.”
entries.menuText: “I do not want to associate with a media mogul. Reject the offer.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I would like to hear your opinion,..."
entries.dialogueText: “I would like to hear your opinion, Petr.”
entries.menuText: “I would like to hear your opinion, Petr.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: BaseGame.Turn01_Admin_Meeting = true

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You go ahead. Connect the line to..."
entries.dialogueText: “You go ahead. Connect the line to my office.”
entries.menuText: “You go ahead. Connect the line to my office.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'll talk to him. Connect the line..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'll talk to him. Connect the line to my office.”
entries.menuText: “I'll talk to him. Connect the line to my office.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A few minutes passed as the two tal..."
entries.dialogueText: A few minutes passed as the two talked over the phone.

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“The pleasure is all mine.”"
entries.dialogueText: “The pleasure is all mine.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“The President speaking.”"
entries.dialogueText: “The President speaking.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It's a pleasure, Mr. Koronti.”"
entries.dialogueText: “It's a pleasure, Mr. Koronti.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Hello, Marcel.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Hello, Marcel.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“He is going to offer a real deal a..."
entries.dialogueText: “He is going to offer a real deal and now has the power of the conglomerate too. The choice is up to you, Mr. President. I can set up the meeting soon.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Greetings, Mr. Rayne.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Greetings, Mr. Rayne.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“It's an honor, Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “It's an honor, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“The board has decided rather quick..."
entries.dialogueText: “The board has decided rather quickly. It seems that gave him the confidence to approach us again.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“I know your time is valuable, so I..."
entries.dialogueText: “I know your time is valuable, so I will not waste any of it. I was just elected CEO of HOS.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Thank you for the offer. I would b..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you for the offer. I would be interested in a meeting.”
entries.menuText: “Thank you for the offer. I would be interested in a meeting.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Thank you for your offer, Mr. Koro..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you for your offer, Mr. Koronti, but I have to refuse.”
entries.menuText: “Thank you for your offer, Mr. Koronti, but I have to refuse.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“You will not be disappointed, I pr..."
entries.dialogueText: “You will not be disappointed, I promise.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“That is a shame. Thank you for you..."
entries.dialogueText: “That is a shame. Thank you for your time nonetheless.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Mr. Koronti hung up the phone witho..."
entries.dialogueText: Mr. Koronti hung up the phone without waiting for my response.

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Well then, I will let you return t..."
entries.dialogueText: “Well then, I will let you return to your packed schedule. See you later, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“I have to say I'm torn. If he has..."
entries.dialogueText: “I have to say I'm torn. If he has become the CEO, then he has enormous influence now. On the other hand, do we want to privately meet with someone we don't fully know?”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“The meeting would help us figure h..."
entries.dialogueText: “The meeting would help us figure him out. We could still say no to whatever he offers.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Arrange the meeting with Mr. Koron..."
entries.dialogueText: “Arrange the meeting with Mr. Koronti.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I do not want to associate with a..."
entries.dialogueText: “I do not want to associate with a media mogul. Reject the offer.”
entries.menuText: “I do not want to associate with a media mogul. Reject the offer.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I'll set things up right away. Exp..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'll set things up right away. Expect a worthwhile meeting next month.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“That is a clear no. Very well. I h..."
entries.dialogueText: “That is a clear no. Very well. I hope we have made the right call.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“It appears we're done for today. W..."
entries.dialogueText: “It appears we're done for today. We will continue where we left off later. Thank you for your time.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Good work with Marcel. Keep it up...."
entries.dialogueText: “Good work with Marcel. Keep it up.”
entries.menuText: “Good work with Marcel. Keep it up.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“See you soon, gentlemen.”"
entries.dialogueText: “See you soon, gentlemen.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“It's settled then. Looking forward..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's settled then. Looking forward to next month. I wonder if he has a pool?”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Well, that makes things clear. We..."
entries.dialogueText: “Well, that makes things clear. We should focus on other things anyway.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti

entries.dialogueText: “Good luck in the future.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We were already getting the attenti..."
entries.dialogueText: We were already getting the attention of key figures -- and potentially dangerous ones.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian and Petr arrived at my offic..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian and Petr arrived at my office to talk about recent developments and the media strategy.

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“This is why I am offering a partne..."
entries.dialogueText: “This is why I am offering a partnership deal regarding our media branch. I would like to formally invite you to my resort near Conriat for a meeting to discuss the details.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“My strategy in the running of this..."
entries.dialogueText: “My strategy in the running of this conglomerate will be different than my father's approach.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What does he want?”"
entries.dialogueText: “What does he want?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Why is Konrath sending his son?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Why is Konrath sending his son?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Why should I meet with him?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Why should I meet with him?”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian turned to me."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian turned to me.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“He, uh, unfortunately passed away..."
entries.dialogueText: “He, uh, unfortunately passed away today.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Which means it would be wise to ha..."
entries.dialogueText: “Which means it would be wise to have them by our side. Sorry for interrupting.”

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: "“It's Livia, Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “It's Livia, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Livia Suno, my new secretary, enter..."
entries.dialogueText: Livia Suno, my new secretary, entered the office.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Would you like to talk to him, sir..."
entries.dialogueText: “Would you like to talk to him, sir, or would you like me to?”

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: "“Right away, sir. Connecting the ca..."
entries.dialogueText: “Right away, sir. Connecting the call to line one.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Livia left the room and the phone s..."
entries.dialogueText: Livia left the room and the phone started ringing. Lucian picked it up.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian looked at his watch."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian looked at his watch.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian and Petr gathered their docu..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian and Petr gathered their documents and promptly left my office.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What does that entail?”"
entries.dialogueText: “What does that entail?”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Our future as partners, Mr. Presid..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our future as partners, Mr. President. Surely, we can't talk about the details on the phone. I just wish to have a face to face conversation with you.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“I will send you the details throug..."
entries.dialogueText: “I will send you the details through my secretary if you are interested.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“See you later, Mr. Koronti.”"
entries.dialogueText: “See you later, Mr. Koronti.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I hung up the phone."
entries.dialogueText: I hung up the phone.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Goodbye.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Goodbye.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They both took their seats across f..."
entries.dialogueText: They both took their seats across from me. Lucian put on his reading glasses and quickly went over some documents. Petr turned to Lucian and nodded.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Greetings, gentlemen.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Greetings, gentlemen.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He was the oldest son of Konrath Ko..."
entries.dialogueText: He was the oldest son of Konrath Koronti, the industrialist and media mogul who founded HOS. The richest man in the entirety of Sordland.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Sounds like there is potential the..."
entries.dialogueText: “Sounds like there is potential there.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“However, as Petr said, they have s..."
entries.dialogueText: “However, as Petr said, they have substantial power over the content of media outlets. Headlines, radio shows. That is what he would be offering. What he wants in return is what we need to understand.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I agree. We need to be careful.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I agree. We need to be careful.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“There is definitely potential. A p..."
entries.dialogueText: “There is definitely potential. A potential that could go both ways.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“He did not wish to explain the det..."
entries.dialogueText: “He did not wish to explain the details over the phone but rather in person. I believe I will be receiving a call from him sometime soon.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian and Petr nodded before gathe..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian and Petr nodded before gathering their documents and leaving my office.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her dark curls bounced as she cross..."
entries.dialogueText: Her dark curls bounced as she crossed the room to my desk. She spoke with a slight lilt in her voice.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I have just received further infor..."
entries.dialogueText: “I have just received further information from the Interior about the sudden fire that broke out at the Holsord State University archives nearby.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Is the SID really necessary for th..."
entries.dialogueText: “Is the SID really necessary for this? Why would anyone hit the archives of a university in the first place? I see no logical motive there.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Was it put out quickly?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Was it put out quickly?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Tell me more.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Tell me more.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Our firefighters put out the fire..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our firefighters put out the fire as soon as they could. Yet it had been burning for six hours, so extensive damage was done to the archives and the building.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“The initial reports from the Holso..."
entries.dialogueText: “The initial reports from the Holsord police chief indicate a potential arson case. In accordance with protocol, the Sordish Intelligence Directorate has been called.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'm not interested in the subject...."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm not interested in the subject.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Excuse me. Let's just move on.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Excuse me. Let's just move on.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“More importantly, Lucian mentioned..."
entries.dialogueText: “More importantly, Lucian mentioned that Marcel Koronti contacted him.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“I will arrange medals to recognize..."
entries.dialogueText: “I will arrange medals to recognize their bravery for doing their best. The Holsord Fire Department is full of tough champs.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“It seems like the chief suspects f..."
entries.dialogueText: “It seems like the chief suspects foreign sabotage. They informed us that a large section of the archive has been destroyed. It included tens of thousands of globally recognized research documents in original by the great thinkers of our people.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It's a shame so much knowledge was..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's a shame so much knowledge was lost.”
entries.menuText: “It's a shame so much knowledge was lost.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Back to Petr's point. If this was..."
entries.dialogueText: “Back to Petr's point. If this was arson, what could the motive have been?"
entries.menuText: “Back to Petr's point. If this was arson, what could the motive have been?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We need to support our education s..."
entries.dialogueText: “We need to support our education system to make new discoveries for the future.”
entries.menuText: “We need to support our education system to make new discoveries for the future.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Luckily most originals have copies..."
entries.dialogueText: “Luckily most originals have copies in the other universities and some international libraries. The first edition of my favorite book, "The Geopolitics of Sordland" by Herman Equa, was destroyed too.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“The fact that the employee records..."
entries.dialogueText: “The fact that the employee records have been destroyed along with the research documents raises further questions.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Preserving our knowledge is as imp..."
entries.dialogueText: “Preserving our knowledge is as important as expanding on it. It's interesting that the employee records have been destroyed as well.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Maybe it was just a freak accident..."
entries.dialogueText: “Maybe it was just a freak accident. We do have the copies of most important works, so no single fire can eradicate our knowledge. I see no point in destroying employee records, either.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“The information we received raises..."
entries.dialogueText: “The information we received raises some eyebrows.”
